name: Menagerie
description: An Ender Dragon, a Warden and an Elder Guardian serve you alongside your Wither Storm, and none of them break a block. The Warden fights whatever you hit or whatever hits you (even other Wardens). The Elder Guardian curses those same enemies with weakness, slowness and mining fatigue, and blesses you with Conduit Power, Haste, Speed and Strength while it is near. The Dragon follows you and breathes on your enemies. Right-click the Ender Dragon to step into your Pocket Realm, a private endless flat world floored with barriers that only you can enter or leave this way; right-click the Dragon again to return.
